semanticModels: not used by V10; retained only for the legacy V9 page
architecture: V10 WebXR geometry workflow: scan -> model -> frame-quality. WebXR is the metric backbone; automatic keyframes are fused only after affine metric alignment against WebXR anchors. Every user-saved photograph first receives a visible Depth Anything relative-depth preview and contributes RGB-colored surfels only after the user confirms it; rejected or declined frames leave the WebXR map unchanged. A V10 RAW room ZIP preserves the verified colored surfel cloud, WebXR poses/depth frames, raw XR geometry, and lossless RGBA user photographs so the room can be reopened and its Depth Anything previews reprocessed without a new AR session. SAM is not loaded or used by V10. Audio remains available only in the legacy V9 workflow.
patch: V10.0.8: verifies and smoke-tests Depth Anything with visible progress before WebXR scanning, reports the exact readiness/failure state, and adds self-contained RAW room save/reopen and later Depth Anything reprocessing.
